handoff.objective: Archive the two independent review reports and administrative finite-audit decision after verified producer snapshot; preserve disjoint archive custody.
constraints: Commit alone in the isolated branch
Stage exact own and reviewer source artifact paths only
Exclude all earlier producer snapshot-owned artifacts
Do not rewrite protocol or original handoffs
No hypothesis or goal status promotion; no EV-* record is asserted
Record actual commit and publication state; never fabricate external review or push
completion_gate: Both review tasks completed against verified producer snapshot with read-set/session attestations
Decision records exact finite tested scope, known limitations, procedure deviations and next action; no goal/hypothesis transition
Archive binds reviewer outputs and own decision path without earlier snapshot-owned files
Post-commit receipt verifies parent,changed paths,SHA256 and record IDs; remote publication status stated accurately
